CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.workspace_capture_event_time_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.capture_time_source='razorpay_payment_captured_event_v1' AND
    (TG_OP='INSERT' OR NEW.captured_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.captured_at OR NEW.capture_time_source IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.capture_time_source) THEN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM workspace_payment_events e JOIN workspace_membership_orders o ON o.id=NEW.membership_order_id
   WHERE e.provider_account_id=NEW.provider_account_id AND e.provider_mode=NEW.provider_mode
     AND e.event_type='payment.captured' AND e.anomaly_hash IS NULL
     AND e.evidence->>'providerOrderId'=NEW.provider_order_id AND e.evidence->>'providerPaymentId'=NEW.provider_payment_id
     AND (e.evidence->>'eventCreatedAt')::timestamptz=NEW.captured_at
     AND NEW.captured_at<=e.received_at AND NEW.captured_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
     AND NEW.captured_at>=o.created_at AND NEW.captured_at>=NEW.provider_created_at
     AND o.user_id=NEW.user_id AND o.provider_account_id=NEW.provider_account_id AND o.provider_mode=NEW.provider_mode
     AND o.provider_order_id=NEW.provider_order_id AND NEW.state='captured' AND NEW.amount_paise=o.total_paise AND NEW.currency='INR' AND o.currency='INR'
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Capture time requires matching durable capture event' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.workspace_email_challenge_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Email challenge history is retained' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','attempts','accepted_at','consumed_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','attempts','accepted_at','consumed_at'])
 OR NEW.attempts<OLD.attempts OR NEW.attempts>OLD.attempts+1
 OR (OLD.accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.accepted_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.accepted_at)
 OR (OLD.state<>NEW.state AND NOT ((OLD.state='sending' AND NEW.state IN ('accepted','failed','uncertain','superseded')) OR (OLD.state='accepted' AND NEW.state IN ('superseded','expired','exhausted','consumed')) OR (OLD.state='uncertain' AND NEW.state='superseded')))
 OR (OLD.state IN ('consumed','exhausted','expired','failed','superseded') AND NEW IS DISTINCT FROM OLD) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid email challenge transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.workspace_new_order_refund_policy_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE d workspace_refund_policy_versions;
BEGIN
  -- Prospective only: existing nullable snapshots are preserved; no historical UPDATE/backfill.
  SELECT * INTO d FROM workspace_refund_policy_versions WHERE is_current FOR SHARE;
  IF NOT FOUND OR NEW.refund_policy_acceptance_id IS NULL
     OR NEW.refund_policy_version IS DISTINCT FROM d.policy_version
     OR NEW.refund_policy_content_hash IS DISTINCT FROM d.content_hash
     OR NEW.refund_policy_accepted_at IS NULL OR NEW.refund_policy_accepted_at < d.effective_at
     OR NEW.refund_policy_accepted_at > NEW.created_at OR NEW.created_at > clock_timestamp() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'New Workspace orders require current Refund Policy acceptance' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  -- Composite FK verifies acceptance ID, owner, version, hash and timestamp together.
  -- Existing workspace_financial_orders_guard protects all new snapshot columns on UPDATE.
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.workspace_phase15_payment_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Payment evidence cannot be deleted' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND ((to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','winner','last_observed_at','captured_at','capture_time_source','refunded_paise','evidence_hash']) IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','winner','last_observed_at','captured_at','capture_time_source','refunded_paise','evidence_hash'])
    OR (OLD.state='captured' AND NEW.state<>'captured') OR (OLD.winner AND NOT NEW.winner) OR NEW.refunded_paise<OLD.refunded_paise
    OR (OLD.captured_at IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.captured_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.captured_at OR NEW.capture_time_source IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.capture_time_source))) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Payment identity/captured evidence is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.workspace_refund_completion_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE o workspace_membership_orders; p jsonb; r jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO o FROM workspace_membership_orders WHERE id=NEW.membership_order_id FOR UPDATE;
 p:=NEW.evidence->'payment'; r:=NEW.evidence->'refund';
 IF o.id IS NULL OR o.financial_state<>'captured' OR o.winning_payment_id IS NULL OR NEW.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM o.user_id
  OR NEW.provider_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM o.provider_account_id OR NEW.provider_mode IS DISTINCT FROM o.provider_mode OR NEW.provider_payment_id IS DISTINCT FROM o.winning_payment_id
  OR NEW.amount_paise IS DISTINCT FROM o.total_paise OR NEW.currency IS DISTINCT FROM o.currency OR NEW.confirmed_at>clock_timestamp()
  OR NEW.evidence->>'rule' IS DISTINCT FROM 'razorpay_full_refund_fetch_v1'
  OR p->>'accountId' IS DISTINCT FROM o.provider_account_id OR p->>'mode' IS DISTINCT FROM o.provider_mode OR p->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM o.winning_payment_id OR p->>'orderId' IS DISTINCT FROM o.provider_order_id
  OR p->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'captured' OR p->>'currency' IS DISTINCT FROM o.currency OR (p->>'amountPaise')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM o.total_paise
  OR (p->>'refundedPaise')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM o.total_paise OR p->>'refundStatus' IS DISTINCT FROM 'full'
  OR r->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.provider_refund_id OR r->>'paymentId' IS DISTINCT FROM o.winning_payment_id OR r->>'accountId' IS DISTINCT FROM o.provider_account_id OR r->>'mode' IS DISTINCT FROM o.provider_mode
  OR r->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'processed' OR r->>'currency' IS DISTINCT FROM o.currency OR (r->>'amountPaise')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM o.total_paise THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Full refund requires exact scoped processed provider evidence' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.workspace_refund_notice_insert_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF (NEW.kind='completed' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_refund_completions WHERE membership_order_id=NEW.membership_order_id))
  OR (NEW.kind='received' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_refund_requests WHERE membership_order_id=NEW.membership_order_id))
  OR (NEW.kind='rejected' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_refund_requests WHERE membership_order_id=NEW.membership_order_id AND decision='rejected'))
  OR (NEW.kind='initiated' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_refund_attempts WHERE membership_order_id=NEW.membership_order_id AND provider_refund_id IS NOT NULL AND state IN ('processing','completed'))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Refund notices require the corresponding committed workflow fact' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
